method: City polylines projected to EPSG:26914, split at intersections, vertices within two metres joined; shortest walking distance to each endpoint. St. Edward's Park Loop uses distinct mapped paths between park junctions, reached by an out-and-back Forest Ridge approach. Bull Creek Loop turns at the last Lakewood-connected creekside vertex; the next City segment is separated by a mapped gap and no passage is assumed. North road pickup is one way. Network miles count each edge of the connected component once; they are not a single through route. Creek candidates come from intersection with the OSM channel centerline. Exact parking approach, crossing structure, tributary crossings, and passability have not been surveyed.
